subject.title: fix: avoid false macOS gateway restart failures

question: Should a loaded canonical macOS KeepAlive LaunchAgent receive the full bounded restart-health window instead of the earlier stopped-and-free failure verdict?
rationale: Both outcomes are deliberate availability semantics: the longer wait prevents proven false failures during launchd throttling but delays reporting when a supervised service is genuinely unrecoverable.

options.title: Accept bounded supervised wait
options.body: Land the current behavior so loaded macOS KeepAlive restarts may use the existing bounded deadline while all other paths retain early failure.

options.title: Require stricter supervisor evidence
options.body: Pause landing until the caller proves KeepAlive policy more directly than loaded LaunchAgent state, accepting additional complexity for a narrower exception.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded supervised wait
recommendation.body: Land the current behavior so loaded macOS KeepAlive restarts may use the existing bounded deadline while all other paths retain early failure.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal ties this person to the restart-health polling and early-exit policy being adjusted.
